title: Interface catalogue
description:
One language's translation of the app's interface. A tree of message keys whose leaves are the sentences shown on screen.

The *keys* are not described here, on purpose: they belong to the app, they change with it, and a copy of them in this repository would be a copy that falls out of step. What this schema checks is the shape — an object of objects of strings — and validate.mjs is what holds every translation to the same keys as the reference.

node.description: Either a sentence or a group of them.

anyOf.description: A sentence shown on screen. Empty is refused: a blank row looks like a bug to a viewer and like a finished translation to whoever wrote it.
